title: bartlettina pinabetensis
intro: Bartlettina pinabetensis, commonly known as Calea pinabetensis or Bartlettina pinabettensis, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia, making it a promising natural remedy for stress relief and sleep disorders. The therapeutic actions of Bartlettina pinabetensis have been attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenoids and other secondary metabolites. Studies on the plant have identified its potential to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, leading to a calming effect and relaxation response.
